<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="20" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000DE">9:41</text>
    <rect x="318" y="12" width="16" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000DE" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="334" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000DE"/>
    <rect x="320" y="14" width="3" height="6" rx="1" fill="#000000DE"/>
    <rect x="325" y="13" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000DE"/>
    <rect x="330" y="11" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#000000DE"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="17" r="2" fill="#000000DE"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="17" r="2" fill="#000000DE"/>
    <circle cx="363" cy="17" r="2" fill="#000000DE"/>
    <line x1="371" y1="13" x2="377" y2="13" stroke="#000000DE" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="371" y1="17" x2="377" y2="17" stroke="#000000DE" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative recycling illustration -->
  <g opacity="0.12">
    <circle cx="111" cy="224" r="63" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="104" cy="210" r="38" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="78" y="183" width="52" height="20" rx="10" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="88" y="203" width="32" height="56" rx="16" fill="#000000"/>
    <polygon points="150,225 175,210 170,231" fill="#000000"/>
    <polygon points="56,219 85,192 89,230" fill="#000000"/>
    <polygon points="125,261 147,282 119,289" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="137" cy="187" r="11" fill="#000000"/>
    <polygon points="151,166 184,171 168,190" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="57" y="255" width="32" height="20" rx="6" fill="#000000"/>
    <polygon points="73,244 96,253 75,268" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="165" cy="250" r="14" fill="#000000"/>
    <polygon points="166,229 193,243 171,261" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Welcome content -->
  <rect x="40" y="257" width="140" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <text x="40" y="214" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Hello User</text>
  <text x="40" y="252" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Welcome Back</text>
  <text x="40" y="291" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">We are here to help you through waste recycling</text>

  <!-- Login card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="39" y="321" width="312" height="299" rx="23" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="45" y="327" width="300" height="287" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.55"/>

    <text x="63" y="362" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Enter your number to continue</text>

    <text x="63" y="398" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000DE">Phone number</text>
    <rect x="63" y="408" width="268" height="45" rx="10" fill="#E9E9E9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="78" y="436" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#757575">Enter your number here.....</text>
    <line x1="78" y1="430" x2="86" y2="430" stroke="#757575" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="86" y1="430" x2="84" y2="426" stroke="#757575" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="86" y1="430" x2="84" y2="434" stroke="#757575" stroke-width="1.2"/>

    <text x="63" y="485" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000DE">We’ll send an OTP to verify your account.</text>
    <text x="63" y="518" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#000000DE">Don’t have an account ? Sign up</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="63" y="531" width="104" height="33" rx="40" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="115" y="553" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign In</text>
    </g>

    <g>
      <rect x="179" y="531" width="104" height="33" rx="40" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="231" y="553" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Use Email</text>
    </g>

    <g opacity="0.95">
      <rect x="281" y="374" width="34" height="34" rx="10" fill="#0000001A"/>
      <circle cx="298" cy="390" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="303" y1="395" x2="308" y2="400" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom nav background -->
  <rect x="0" y="748" width="390" height="96" rx="20" fill="#E2E2E2"/>
  <rect x="125" y="790" width="140" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Bottom nav tabs -->
  <g>
    <g transform="translate(26,768)">
      <rect x="14" y="0" width="20" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polygon points="24,-8 12,2 36,2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="24" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(104,768)">
      <circle cx="24" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <rect x="16" y="20" width="16" height="8" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="24" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Pickup</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(183,768)">
      <polygon points="24,0 28,8 37,9 30,15 32,24 24,19 16,24 18,15 11,9 20,8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="24" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Rewards</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(262,768)">
      <circle cx="24" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <rect x="16" y="19" width="16" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="24" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Account</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(334,768)">
      <rect x="12" y="6" width="24" height="16" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="16" y1="11" x2="32" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="16" y1="16" x2="28" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="24" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Help</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
